razorfmt - Deterministic, Prettier-grade code formatter for ASP.NET Core Razor (.cshtml/.razor)

Usage:
  razorfmt [options] <files/folders...>       Format files in place
  razorfmt check [options] <files/folders...> Check formatting without modifying files
  razorfmt diff [options] <files/folders...>  Display formatting differences (unified diff)
  cat file.cshtml | razorfmt                  Format standard input to standard output

Commands:
  check                       Check files and exit with code 1 if unformatted
  diff                        Print unified diff of unformatted files and exit with code 1

Options:
  -c, --check                 Same as 'check' subcommand
  -d, --diff                  Same as 'diff' subcommand
  -w, --write                 Format in-place (default for file/directory paths)
      --stdout                Print formatted text to stdout instead of overwriting
      --server                Start persistent stdio JSON-RPC formatting server
      --changes-json          Output discrete text changes and diagnostics as JSON
      --verbose               Display detailed file processing information
      --tab                   Use tabs for indentation (default: spaces)
      --indent <n>            Number of spaces per indentation level (default: 4)
      --lf                    Enforce Unix line endings (LF)
      --crlf                  Enforce Windows line endings (CRLF)
      --attribute-layout <l>  Attribute layout: preserve, one-per-line, single-line
      --config <path>         Path to explicit .editorconfig file
      --ignore <pattern>      Pattern to ignore (can be repeated)
  -v, --version               Display version information
  -h, --help                  Display this help message

Exit Codes:
  0                           Success; no formatting issues found or files formatted
  1                           Formatting differences found in check/diff mode
  2                           Invalid arguments or configuration
  3                           File access or format
[truncated]
